description:
Damage sites for Earthquake, Myanmar, 28 March 2025 (EQ20250328MMR): 135,981 features merged from 69 source layers. Point layers with a damage class column (such as `Main_Damage_Site_Class`): one point per assessed structure or site. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment in Mahaaungmyay, Chanmyathazi and Chanayethazan Townships, Mandalay District, Mandalay Region, Myanmar as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-mahaaungmyay-chanmyathazi-and-chanayethazan-townships-mandalay-distri)
- [Damage Assessment in Mandalay & Sagaing Districts, Myanmar as of 03 April 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-mandalay-sagaing-districts-myanmar-as-of-03-april-2025)
- [Damage Assessment in Monywa Township, Monywa District, Sagaing Region, Myanmar as of 25 April 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-monywa-township-monywa-district-sagaing-region-myanmar-as-of-25-april)
- [Damage Assessment in Sagaing Township, Sagaing District, Sagaing Region, Myanmar as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-sagaing-township-sagaing-district-sagaing-region-myanmar-as-of-30-mar)
- [Damage Assessment in Sagaing and Mandalay, Myanmar as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-sagaing-and-mandalay-myanmar-as-of-30-march-2025)
- [Damage Assessment in Wundwin Township, Meiktila District Mandalay Region, Myanmar as of 01 April 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-wundwin-township-meiktila-district-mandalay-region-myanmar-as-of-01-a)
- [M7.7 28 March 2025 Sagaing Earthquake, Satellite-Based Comprehensive Damage Assessment Report](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/m7-7-28-march-2025-sagaing-earthquake-satellite-based-comprehensive-damage-assessment-repo)
- [Satellite-detected Damage in the Cultural Property Mahamuni Pagoda as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-damage-in-the-cultural-property-mahamuni-pagoda-as-of-30-march-2025)
- [Satellite-detected Damage to Cultural Heritage in Tada-U as of 03 April 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/satellite-detected-damage-to-cultural-heritage-in-tada-u-as-of-03-april-2025)
- [Satellite-detected damage in the UNESCO Tentative List Site, Ancient Cities of Upper Myanmar: Innwa as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-in-the-unesco-tentative-list-site-ancient-cities-of-upper-myanmar-innwa-as-of-30-ma)
- [Satellite-detected damage in the UNESCO Tentative List Site, Ancient Cities of Upper Myanmar: Mandalay as of 30 March 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-in-the-unesco-tentative-list-site-ancient-cities-of-upper-myanmar-mandalay-as-of-30)
- [Satellite-detected damage in the UNESCO World Heritage Site, Bagan: Component 7 as of 03 April 2025](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-in-the-unesco-world-heritage-site-bagan-component-7-as-of-03-april-2025)
- and 3 more; the event's [catalog page](../catalog.json) lists them all.

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SiteID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `SiteID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = WorldView-1; 2 = WorldView-2; 3 = QuickBird-2; 4 = Ikonos; 5 = GeoEye-1; 6 = Formosat-2; 7 = SPOT-5; 8 = WorldView-3; 9 = MODIS-Aqua; 10 = MODIS-Terra; 11 = ASTER; 12 = EO-1 ALI; 13 = EO-1 Hyperion; 14 = MERIS; 15 = Landsat-7; 16 = Landsat-5; 17 = ASAR WSM; 18 = ASAR IMP; 19 = ASAR GM1; 20 = ASAR AP; 21 = Radarsat-1; 22 = Radarsat-2; 23 = TerraSAR-X; 24 = CosmoSkyMED; 25 = SPOT-4; 26 = ALOS PALSAR; 27 = ASAR IMM; 30 = UAV (Swinglet-Cam); 33 = Alos AVNIR; 35 = Pleiades; 36 = DMC; 37 = RISAT-1; 38 = RISAT-2; 39 = RESOURCESAT-1; 40 = Landsat-8; 41 = SPOT-6; 42 = Sentinel-1; 43 = Kompsat-2; 44 = Sentinel-2; 45 = Sentinel-3; 46 = Kompsat-3; 47 = Deimos-2; 48 = TripleSat; 49 = PlanetLabs; 50 = RapidEye; 51 = WorldView-4; 52 = SPOT-7; 53 = Jilin-1; 54 = GaoFen-2; 55 = SkySat; 56 = ICEYE; 57 = Landsat-9; 58 = VIIRS-NOAA; 59 = RCM-1; 60 = RCM-2; 61 = RCM-3; 62 = TanDEM-X; 63 = BlackSky; …. The decoded text is in `SensorID_label`.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 3 source files of this collection use 3 different domains for it, so read `Main_Damage_Site_Class_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Damaged Buildings; 2 = Damaged Greenhouses; 3 = Impacts on Roads / Bridges; 4 = Impacts in Fields; 5 = Damaged Road segments; 6 = Damaged Port. The decoded text is in `Grouped_Damage_Classes_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes_label
table:columns.description: `Grouped_Damage_Classes` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class_label
table:columns.description: `Main_Damage_Site_Class` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SiteID_label
table:columns.description: `SiteID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
